units.detail: DUNLENDING HORSEMAN source messy shaggy BLACK hair, face angled down and no added longbeard, rugged BROWN FUR cloak/collar over brown leather/chainmail armor, brownbracers/boots, simple bronze roundcloakclasp. BROWN HORSE long LIGHT BROWN mane/tail, WHITE blaze on forehead/nose, plain brown/gold bridle and simple darkbrown saddle/blanket, no redblue heraldicbarding. ViewerLEFT hand ONE short BROWN-handled AXE with curved SILVER singleblade held beside shoulder pointing outward at y15%, short elbow not overhead stretch. Other hand reins at belt with ROUND TAN WOOD SHIELD strapped to OUTER forearm: black iron diagonal crossbands and FOUR ivory stud/spikes around rim like source. Exactly2hands, no extra shieldhand. Rider compact5head bones, horse nearfront with modest step. Preserve source mutedbrown palette, no horns/helmet/coloredcape added.
units.prompt: Dress IMAGE1 original NEUTRAL HUMAN skeleton as IMAGE2 character. IMAGE1 alone controls normal adult skull, torso/limb bone lengths and elevated front camera. EXACTLY FIVE anatomical heads crown-to-sole, one head crown-to-CHIN excluding HAIR, BEARD, HAT or crown. No4head bighead chibi, no6+head tall hero. Copy exact bone segment relationships, use old age/slenderness through face, width and posture only. Full robes cover same compact fivehead bones, never lengthen body or hide feet. If hat/staff needs space, zoom out whole figure and expand clear canvas padding; do NOT shrink body relative to head to fit hat. Image2 identity/equipment/palette only, ignore its proportions. New joint poses required while preserving bone LENGTHS. Elevated FRONT camera looking DOWN30deg, clear TOP planes of head/hat and both shoulders, foreshortened chest/face, chin/gaze angled down separately. Not eyelevel with only bowed head. Crisp discrete pixel clusters, stepped dark outlines, limited color ramps matching image1/new Gondor/Mordor, no smooth painting/3D. Entire figure/weapons inside transparent RGBA clear margin, torso centered independently of equipment. No floor/base/shadow/aura/glow/text. Replace neutral bald scalp with required HAIR/BEARD/HAT exactly as source.  MOUNTED unit: Image1 human-mounted neutral controls ONLY rider normal skull/torso/femur/shin BONE LENGTHS and elevated camera. FIVE anatomical heads if rider stands; inspect rider independently from animal total height. Ignore footstanding framing. Animal anatomy/color/species come from image2; no5head rule for animal, no uniform shrinking of mount/rider to fix ratios. Show TOP planes of rider skull, shoulders, saddle and animal neck/withers/head through genuinely elevated front camera, not only bowed head. Exactly2hands on specified objects. Rider compact5head bones, horse nearfront with modest step. Preserve source mutedbrown palette, no horns/helmet/coloredcape added.
